description: No spec subject (candidates: specled.severity / CLI output surface when picked up). Severity: Low. From 2026-08-06 critical review of specled_-q0q. The new append_only/self_authorized_weakening marker resolves to :info, and default CLI output does not render :info findings — the always-visible marker the epic shipped is in practice visible only in HTML review output or verbose modes. Keep-reason: CLI output-policy change (how :info renders by default) needs its own small design call; out of scope for the defect branch. Concrete failure: a maintainer running bare mix spec.check on a self-authorizing PR sees a green result with no marker line, defeating the visibility intent.
title: F25: :info findings invisible on default CLI output — self-auth marker only visible with --debug/HTML
